archetypes.name: dyn-ledger-gap
archetypes.rationale: Inspect gap and final-removal ledger summary behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the skill-closure ledger summary changes around absent targets, reappearing targets, and final snapshot removals. Check that detailed ledger behavior is unchanged and that the regression test would fail for both the old in-loop zero behavior and a skip-only partial fix. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
